items.title: OpenAI GPT-6.1 Terra is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock
items.blurb: Today, AWS announces the general availability of OpenAI GPT-6.1 Terra on Amazon Bedrock. GPT-6.1 Terra expands the GPT-6 family with a balance of capability, speed, and cost efficiency for everyday workloads.

items.title: Amazon WorkSpaces Core Managed Instances now supports ModifyVolume API
items.blurb: Amazon WorkSpaces Core Managed Instances now supports the ModifyVolume API, which lets you change volume size, volume type, IOPS, or throughput in place, without detaching the volume or restarting the instance.

items.title: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio adds light mode support for IDC-based domains
items.blurb: Today, AWS announces light mode support in Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio for Identity Center (IDC) based domains. Customers can now configure the visual interface mode to match their preference, choosing between dark and light themes.

items.title: Amazon Connect Customer expands testing and simulation to validate flow action outcomes
items.blurb: Amazon Connect Customer now enables you to validate the outcomes of your customer experience flow actions during testing and simulation.

items.title: Amazon Connect Customer now lets you view metrics by customer lifetime value and repeat-caller status
items.blurb: Now you can view your metrics across customer segments: customer lifetime value (LTV) and repeat callers.

items.title: Amazon Connect Customer now measures the outcomes that drive retention and revenue
items.blurb: Amazon Connect Customer now scores the outcome of your customer interactions. It shows whether the customer left satisfied, is at risk of churning, made a purchase, or resolved their need in self-service.

items.title: DigitalOcean Launches Learning and Data Services to Enable Self-Improving AI Agents
items.blurb: DigitalOcean has announced the public preview of Learning Services and Agent Data Services, enabling developers to build, evaluate, and continuously improve AI agents within a unified, AI-native, cloud platform. By Sergio De Simone
